reports.title: H2O America Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

lines: •2026 standalone adjusted diluted EPS guidance, which excludes the impacts of the Quadvest and pending Cibolo Valley acquisitions and the financings thereof, narrowed to $3.10-$3.161 (midpoint remains $3.13). 2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance, including the impacts of the acquisitions and the financings thereof, initiated at $2.91-$2.971
As previously communicated, we expect the addition of Quadvest to drive Texas from 8% of our consolidated customer base at year-end 2025 to 26% by 2029.
The company is narrowing standalone 2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance to $3.10-$3.16, preserving the $3.13 midpoint of the original $3.08-$3.181 range.

With the close of the Quadvest acquisition on October 1, we are providing 2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance of $2.91-$2.97, which incorporates the anticipated impacts of Quadvest and the pending Cibolo Valley acquisitions, including the financings thereof.
Further, we continue to expect to deliver a non-linear adjusted diluted EPS CAGR at or above the top end of the 6-8% range over the 2026-30 period.
The 2026 annualized dividend is expected to be $1.76 per share compared with $1.68 per share in 2025.
